overview_description.description:
Sleep is one third of our lives. If it is not working well the other two thirds are likely to suffer. Around 50% of adults have a sleep disorder, and these disorders are extremely underdiagnosed and undertreated.

This is where Wink comes in. Founded in 2014 in San Francisco, they are a team of technologists, and clinicians translating clinical research and expertise into simple, effective web and mobile services.

They envision a future where anyone can have instant and affordable access to world-class sleep medicine.
